visual_overrides.core_identity: A dead ogre animated into a slow hulking corpse, preserving huge ogre proportions while showing restrained unmistakable undeath.
visual_overrides.silhouette: Massive slumped giant with drooping shoulders, uneven gait, thick limbs, and dragging chains.
visual_overrides.head_features: Broad ogre face with sunken eyes, slack jaw, and restrained corpse damage; no graphic gore.
visual_overrides.body_shape: Huge heavy ogre frame with sagging posture, stiff joints, and asymmetrical undead movement.
visual_overrides.surface: Sparse torn skin, a few simple damage lines, and no dense gore or decay texture.
